Collecting a <solar/>Firesprite or scoring ? <solar/>Solar Kills within ? seconds of each grants 'Forge Master' for 12 seconds. Buff timer starts once <solar/>Throwing Hammer is used.

While Forge Master is active, <solar/>Throwing Hammer is granted improved tracking and can be recalled by pressing your melee input.

Recalling after 2? seconds of scoring a <solar/>Throwing Hammer hit performs a Perfect Recall.

Perfect Recall triggers an explosion at the Hammer's location that deals up to <pve 290 /> <pvp [?] /> Damage in a ~5 meter radius.

Performing Perfect Recalls and picking up additional <solar/>Firesprites extends the buff duration by 3 seconds, up to 12 seconds.

Collecting a <solar/>Firesprite or scoring 3 <solar/>Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each grants 'Forge Master' for 12 seconds. Buff timer starts once <solar/>Throwing Hammer is used.

Upon initially gaining Forge Master, generate ~11.7% Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds.

While Forge Master is active, <solar/>Throwing Hammer is granted improved tracking and can be recalled by pressing your melee input. Recalling your Throwing Hammer guarantees a full refund of the ability, regardless of your Melee Stat.

Recalling after ~2? seconds of scoring a <solar/>Throwing Hammer hit performs a Perfect Recall. Perfect Recall triggers an explosion at the Hammer's location that deals up to <pve 290 /> <pvp [?] /> Damage in a ~5 meter radius.

Performing Perfect Recalls and picking up additional <solar/>Firesprites extends the buff duration by 3 seconds, up to 12 seconds.
